content:
The **Broiled Scorchbeast Brain** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

The brain of a Scorchbeast which has been roasted over a fire. This has both improved its taste and made it slightly safer to eat.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Scorchbeast Brain | | Broiled Scorchbeast Brain (1) | 

Can be crafted at any Cooking Station after having picked up a Scorchbeast Brain for the first time.
